arguments.issue: The requested premise conflicts with the checked repository documentation: docs/api.md currently specifies POST /users returns `200 OK`, not `201 Created`. Updating only the test to expect 201 would likely make the integration test fail unless the implementation and/or docs are also changed; shipping with this unresolved contract inconsistency would be misleading.
arguments.recommended_action: Please confirm the intended API contract: (1) retain 200 per current docs, or (2) change the service and docs to 201 and then update the test before shipping.
